dataset.title: H-NS / Fis binding domains
dataset.sourceReference: E. coli MG1655; original study genomic bounds, exact accession not stated in interval table

snapshot.coordinateStatement: Historical source-coordinate warnings are retained in the snapshot. coordinate-evidence.json records the primary-data inference supporting this conversion.

targetReference.bindingAuthority: Empirical primary signal domain and publisher primer-coordinate anchors; original accession is not stated.

layers.featureMeaning: Published binding interval; no score or strand is supplied.

coordinateEvidence.origin: Processed tracks enumerate positions from 1 through 4639675, matching the exact NC_000913.2 reference length. This establishes a one-based position domain empirically.
coordinateEvidence.endMeaning: Across all 27 complete source intervals in the four valid head probes, start is the first threshold-passing position and end is the first threshold-failing position after the interval. All six full interval tables reproduce the published Table 1 total bases using end-start.
coordinateEvidence.conversion: start0 = sourceStart - 1; end0 = sourceEnd - 1. Source end is exclusive in the one-based processed-signal coordinate domain.
coordinateEvidence.referenceBinding: Five publisher validation primer pairs lie within their reported peak intervals on NC_000913.2. Four of those five no longer lie within those intervals on NC_000913.3; its shifts range from 776 to 1978 bases. Every valid signal tail ends at the NC_000913.2 length. The version binding is an empirical coordinate inference, not an author-declared accession.

confidence.originalAuthorAccessionAttribution: moderate; neither accession nor original KEGG FASTA bytes were supplied

measurementMeaning: The tables supply protein-binding interval boundaries only. extent_bp is their reported end-start separation and equals the displayed interval width. It is not a binding signal, strength, affinity, coverage or probability. BED4 has no score field.
missingness: No strength measurements or per-interval strand values are supplied. They remain absent. Unreported genomic regions are not added as zeros. All selected interval extents are present positive integers.
selection: Retain the original 195 mid-exponential records with reported source start below 500000. Do not clip intervals crossing 500000. The original 466 phase-comparison records remain in snapshot and source records; no additional native phase layers are emitted.
limits: Only the selected first-500-kb mid-exponential subset is converted for native placement.

The original accession and original KEGG FASTA bytes were not published in the retrieved interval tables. Exact NC_000913.2 coordinate compatibility is inferred from primary signal and publisher primer anchors.
The signal endpoint check covers 27 intervals across four primary tracks, rather than every selected interval.
Transition and stationary processed-signal probes were unavailable or truncated and were excluded from validation. Their original comparison records are preserved without emitting native layers.
Binding interval extent is not binding strength. No numeric BED score, strand, replicate signal, normalization or zero-filled region is invented.
